entities.summary: Cristina Scuccia is an Italian singer and former Catholic religious sister. She won the 2014 season of The Voice of Italy as part of Team J-Ax, resulting in a record deal with Universal. In 2013, she won a Christian music competition as part of the Good News Festival.
